transc:
Ft. Monroe May 9th 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
The following is first handed in here it is news
to me unity from fortune May plunder for Carlton and
Porter Daily Christian advocate fool zebra a terrific naval Engage
meant in Albemarle sound is wicked zodiac the Shannon bombshell
was piloted back saxon Walpole and the Cotton plant driven
off unity the Wallace Albemarle raptured <insertion>ravished</insertion> postpone of our Sharons
disabling the rudder and piercing the boiler of one of 
them Pekin the Wallace finally retired to the Baden apparently
uninjured pedlar she is armed with plug publish shoals zebra
the land oats upon Flora is apparently over zodiac Chaplain
white of the Providence Conference was on an turtle and
is supposed to be piloted walrus J. Emory Round Sup't
M. E. Mission imogene strange we have not heard this
